from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashMetric(BaseModel):
    """Extracted cash metric from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company reported")
    cash_value: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of 'Cash and Cash Equivalents' as reported")
    cash_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the reported amount, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g., 'March 31, 2024'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_metrics: list[CashMetric]
